title: Human sign-in handoff
summary: After the operator completes a sign-in on a test machine, save it with golden-capture, which proves real requests before recapturing. Diagnose native probe failures first: quota waits for provider capacity, transport waits for recovery, and sign-in advice requires actual authentication evidence. Unknown nonzero failures preserve the golden and direct local diagnosis. A changed-store reset refusal preserves the same diagnosed recovery. Store modification time protects newer credential state without proving a human login.
